title: The shapes of s, p and d orbitals
caption: s orbitals are spheres; each p orbital has two lobes along an axis with a nodal plane between them; most d orbitals have four lobes. The colours show the opposite signs of the wavefunction, which matter when orbitals overlap to form bonds. An orbital has l angular nodes and n − l − 1 radial nodes.
alt: Five orbital shapes: 1s sphere, 2s sphere with an inner sphere of opposite sign, 2pₓ and 2p_z dumbbells, 3d_xy cloverleaf and 3d_z² with a ring.
description: 2s: a sphere with one radial node.
3d_xy: four lobes between the axes, two nodal planes.
3d_z²: two lobes on z and a ring.
